thread.title: Energy Recap: Renewable Energy News - Facebook (NASDAQ:FB)

author: SA Editor Michelle Carini
title: Energy Recap: Renewable Energy News - Facebook (NASDAQ:FB)
text:
Welcome to the latest edition of the Energy Recap. This week, we're leaving you with an abbreviated article ahead of the long weekend. However, we did want to take a moment to pass along some interesting energy-related news from Facebook ( FB ). The company recently announced that it plans to power its global operations with 100% renewable energy by the end of 2020, as well as commit to reducing its greenhouse gas emissions by 75% during the same time period. This continues the trend of tech companies investing in renewable energy, like Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ), Apple ( AAPL ), and Amazon ( AMZN ), among others.
Feel free to leave your thoughts on Facebook's recent announcement or anything else energy related in the comments section below.
